projects.title: Fashion E-Commerce Web Application
projects.bodyText: A responsive Fashion E-Commerce frontend application built using React.js, Redux, HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript. Features component-based architecture, Redux for global state management, responsive layouts using Flexbox and Grid, and dynamic content rendering.

projects.title: Task Management Web Application
projects.bodyText: A Task Management Web Application developed using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript. Allows users to add, edit and delete tasks with dynamic DOM manipulation.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.bodyText: A personal portfolio website developed using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript to showcase personal information, technical skills, education and projects. Designed with a responsive layout and deployed using GitHub Pages.
